title: SWE-PolyBench: A multi-language benchmark for repository level evaluation of coding agents
authors_zh: Muhammad Shihab Rashid, Christian Bock, Yuan Zhuang, Alexander Buchholz, Tim Esler, Simon Valentin, Luca Franceschi, Martin Wistuba, Prabhu Teja Sivaprasad, Woo Jung Kim, Anoop Deoras, Giovanni Zappella, Laurent Callot
paper_type_zh: 多语言仓库级代码 agent benchmark 与可执行补丁评测数据
best_for_zh: 需要多语言仓库修复评测、F2P/P2P 测试或 Docker 化复现实验的研究者。
one_line: SWE-PolyBench pairs 2,110 multi-language repository tasks with Dockerized F2P/P2P tests to measure whether coding-agent patches really resolve an issue.
SWE-PolyBench 为 2,110 个多语言仓库任务提供 Docker 环境与 F2P/P2P 测试，用可执行结果判定代码 agent 补丁是否真正修复问题。
why: Its paired pass/fail test partitions and frozen environment make patch correctness auditable across different language ecosystems.
inclusion_reason: SWE-PolyBench supplies repository tasks with Dockerfiles and F2P/P2P tests, enabling executable verification of generated patches across four languages.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Repository-level coding-agent evaluation remains centered on Python bug fixes, with limited Java, JavaScript, and TypeScript coverage and little separation among feature addition, refactoring, and repair. A final test-pass score also cannot reveal whether an agent failed to locate files, missed syntax nodes, or generated an incorrect patch, limiting diagnosis of multilingual systems.

SWE-PolyBench builds 2,110 executable tasks from 21 real repositories across four languages and three change categories and releases a task- and repository-stratified PB500 subset. In addition to Docker-based test outcomes, it computes retrieval precision and recall over files, functions, classes, and concrete-syntax-tree nodes from gold patches, evaluating both terminal resolution and code localization.

仓库级 coding agent 的主流评测仍以 Python bug fix 为中心，既缺少 Java、JavaScript 和 TypeScript，也很少区分新增功能、重构和修复三类工作。只报告最终测试是否通过还无法说明 agent 是不会定位文件、漏改语法节点，还是生成了错误补丁，因而难以诊断多语言系统的瓶颈。

SWE-PolyBench 从 21 个真实仓库构建 2,110 个执行型任务，覆盖四种语言和三类变更，并发布按任务和仓库分层的 PB500 子集。除 Docker 测试判定外，论文还从 gold patch 的文件、函数与类级语法树节点计算检索 precision/recall，使 benchmark 同时评估终局解决和代码定位。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The main contribution is a repository benchmark combining multiple languages, change types, and structured localization metrics. Its 2,110 instances comprise 165 Java, 1,017 JavaScript, 729 TypeScript, and 199 Python tasks categorized as bug fixes, features, or refactorings. Each record includes issue and pull-request information, base commit, gold and test patches, Dockerfile, test commands, F2P and P2P sets, and syntax-node metadata. A task is included only when the gold patch makes at least one failing test pass without breaking preserved tests. SWE-PolyBench500 uses stratified sampling to reduce evaluation cost, and the harness automatically applies agent patches, executes tests, and reports resolve and localization metrics.

核心贡献是一个同时覆盖多语言、多任务类型和结构化定位指标的仓库级 benchmark。2,110 个实例包括 Java 165、JavaScript 1,017、TypeScript 729 和 Python 199 条，任务分为 bug fix、feature 与 refactoring；每条包含 issue/PR 信息、base commit、gold patch、test patch、Dockerfile、测试命令、F2P/P2P 集及语法节点元数据。只有 gold patch 能使至少一个失败测试通过且不破坏保留测试的实例进入集合。SWE-PolyBench500 用分层抽样降低评测成本，完整 harness 可自动应用 agent patch、运行测试并输出 resolve rate 与定位指标。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Collect real changes: Mine pull requests linked to issues from 21 maintained repositories and retain bug, feature, and refactoring tasks whose source and test patches can be separated.
  1. Build language environments: Create Dockerfiles and test commands for Maven, Gradle, npm, and related ecosystems, install dependencies at the base commit, and verify original tests.
  1. Extract F2P and P2P tests: Compare test states under the base, test patch, and gold patch. Require at least one failing-to-passing test and record regression tests that must remain passing; remove unstable instances.
  1. Generate structural metrics: Parse gold patches to label modified files, functions, classes, and CST nodes, enabling localization precision and recall. Then draw PB500 by language, repository, and task type. Reproduction requires fixed harness, containers, and parser versions.

1. 收集真实变更： 从 21 个维护活跃仓库抓取带 issue 的 PR，保留能分离 source patch 与 test patch 的 bug、feature 和 refactoring 任务。
  1. 构建语言环境： 针对 Maven/Gradle、npm 等生态编写 Dockerfile 和测试命令，在 base commit 上安装依赖并确认原测试可执行。
  1. 提取 F2P/P2P： 比较 base、test patch 和 gold patch 下测试状态，要求至少一个测试由失败变通过，并记录应持续通过的回归测试；无法稳定重放的实例删除。
  1. 生成结构指标： 解析 gold patch，标注修改文件、函数、类和 CST 节点，形成定位 precision/recall；再按语言、仓库和任务类型抽取 PB500。复现需固定 harness、容器与解析器版本。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The authors run several open coding agents on the full set and PB500. Resolve rates are uneven across languages, and simple single-function tasks are much easier than multi-file or multi-node changes. High file-retrieval recall does not necessarily translate into passing tests, showing that localization and patch generation are distinct bottlenecks. Executable replay over 2,110 tasks and 21 repositories demonstrates scale and automation, while CST metrics decompose failures. The paper does not establish strict difficulty matching across languages, and public leaderboard values will change. The well-supported conclusion is that current agents are inconsistent across ecosystems and complex tasks, not that one language is intrinsically harder based on aggregate ranks.

作者在完整集和 PB500 上运行多种开源 coding agent，发现 resolve rate 在语言之间不均衡，简单、单函数任务明显高于多文件和多节点任务；文件检索召回较高并不必然转化为最终测试通过，说明定位与补丁生成是不同瓶颈。2,110 条数据和 21 个仓库的可执行重放表明 benchmark 具有规模和自动化能力，而 CST 指标提供失败分解。论文没有证明各语言任务难度已严格匹配，且公开 leaderboard 会随模型更新；因此核心可信结论是“现有 agent 在跨语言和复杂任务上表现不一致”，不能仅用总体排名推断某语言更难。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Multi-SWE-bench expands language coverage but mainly asks whether an issue is resolved, and standard SWE-bench reporting emphasizes resolve rate. SWE-PolyBench changes both task coverage and diagnostic surface: it includes features and refactorings in addition to bugs and derives file, function, class, and CST-node targets from gold patches to measure localization. It does not change the basic contract of tests as the terminal oracle. Instead, it adds PB500 for cost control and localization metrics so that where an agent fails becomes an explicit benchmark output.

Multi-SWE-bench 扩大语言覆盖，但主要关注 issue 是否解决；SWE-bench 的常用指标也以 resolve rate 为主。SWE-PolyBench 的变化是同时增加任务类型和结构化诊断面：除 bug，还收集 feature/refactoring，并从 gold patch 抽取文件、函数、类和 CST 节点，衡量 agent 找到正确位置的程度。它并未改变测试作为终局 oracle 的基本契约，而是在相同执行评测上加入 PB500 成本控制和定位指标，使“失败在哪里”成为 benchmark 的正式输出。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Distribution imbalance: JavaScript contributes 1,017 tasks while Python has only 199, and repositories and task types are also uneven. Aggregate scores are dominated by large groups, so macro, per-language, and per-repository results should all be reported.
  1. Structural-metric assumption: The gold patch is not the only correct implementation. An agent may edit different files or nodes and still pass tests, yet receive poor localization precision or recall. Structural metrics are diagnostic and cannot replace execution outcomes.
  1. Tests and environments: The benchmark lacks long-tail tasks, tests do not measure maintainability, security, or style, and containerization can constrain major structural changes. Reuse should add human quality review, full suites, and fixed repository and parser versions.

1. 分布不平衡： JavaScript 占 1,017 条，Python 仅 199 条，仓库和任务类型也不均衡；总体分数会被主导语言影响。应同时报告宏平均、每语言和每仓库结果。
  1. 结构指标假设： gold patch 不是唯一正确实现，agent 可能修改不同文件或节点仍通过测试；此时定位 precision/recall 会惩罚有效替代方案。结构指标只能作为诊断，不能替代执行结果。
  1. 测试与环境： 作者指出 benchmark 仍缺少长尾任务，测试无法覆盖可维护性、安全和风格，容器化还限制大规模结构变更。复用时应增加人工质量审查、全量测试，并冻结仓库和解析器版本。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Evaluate multilingual agents: Use PB500 for rapid iteration and the full set for final reporting. Output resolve rate, environment failures, F2P/P2P results, and language- and task-type-specific scores.
  1. Train localization models: Use modified-file, function, class, and CST-node metadata to train repository retrievers or rerankers, then verify whether better localization actually improves repair success.
  1. Analyze failures: Separate failures into missed localization, correct localization without edits, compilation failures, and test failures. Gold-node precision should not be a hard reward when alternative correct patches are expected, and languages without stable Docker environments and tests should not be added directly.

1. 多语言 agent 评测： 使用 PB500 做快速迭代、完整集做最终报告；输出 resolve rate、环境失败、F2P/P2P 和每语言/任务类型结果。
  1. 定位模型训练： 利用 modified_files、函数、类与 CST 节点元数据训练 repository retrieval 或 reranker，再用测试验证定位提升是否真正改善修复成功率。
  1. 失败分析： 将结果分为未定位、定位正确但未修改、补丁编译失败和测试失败。若研究目标是完全不同的正确补丁，不应把 gold-node precision 当硬 reward；无稳定 Docker 和测试的语言也不宜直接加入。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: SWE-PolyBench provides 2,110 four-language repository tasks and combines test resolution with file and CST localization metrics.
  1. Method takeaway: Real pull requests, container building, F2P/P2P replay, structural parsing of gold patches, and PB500 stratified sampling form the pipeline.
  1. Data takeaway: It contains 165 Java, 1,017 JavaScript, 729 TypeScript, and 199 Python tasks across bug, feature, and refactoring categories, with environments and structural metadata.
  1. Evidence anchor: Agent results vary strongly by language and complexity, while localization recall does not guarantee passing tests, revealing multiple independent bottlenecks.
  1. Reuse decision: It fits multilingual evaluation and retrieval diagnosis. Distribution imbalance and non-unique gold patches require stratified reporting and execution-first scoring.

1. 一句话定位： SWE-PolyBench 提供 2,110 个四语言仓库任务，并把测试解决率与文件/CST 定位指标放在同一评测中。
  1. 方法抓手： 真实 PR、容器构建、F2P/P2P 重放、gold patch 结构解析和 PB500 分层抽样构成数据流程。
  1. 数据抓手： Java 165、JS 1,017、TS 729、Python 199，覆盖 bug、feature、refactoring；每条带环境与结构元数据。
  1. 证据锚点： agent 表现随语言和复杂度显著变化，且定位召回并不保证最终测试通过，说明有多个独立瓶颈。
  1. 复用决定： 适合跨语言评测和 retrieval 诊断；最大风险是分布不均和 gold patch 非唯一，必须分层报告并以执行为主。
